title: Tractor with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='40' ry='5' fill='#1a3a2a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- big rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='72' r='16' fill='#2a2a35'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='72' r='12' fill='#444455'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='72' r='5' fill='#888899'/>
  <!-- treads -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='72' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#6a6a80' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-dasharray='3 4'/>

  <!-- small front wheel -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='9' fill='#2a2a35'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='6' fill='#444455'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='2.5' fill='#888899'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='7.5' fill='none' stroke='#6a6a80' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='2 3'/>

  <!-- axle bar -->
  <rect x='28' y='72' width='42' height='4' rx='2' fill='#556655'/>

  <!-- tractor body -->
  <rect x='22' y='48' width='46' height='26' rx='6' fill='#e8a020'/>
  <rect x='22' y='48' width='46' height='6' rx='3' fill='#f5c040'/>

  <!-- engine hood stripe -->
  <rect x='60' y='52' width='8' height='18' rx='2' fill='#cc8010'/>

  <!-- cabin -->
  <rect x='30' y='28' width='26' height='22' rx='4' fill='#f0b830'/>
  <!-- cabin roof -->
  <rect x='26' y='24' width='34' height='7' rx='3' fill='#f5d050'/>
  <!-- window -->
  <rect x='35' y='32' width='16' height='12' rx='2' fill='#80c8e8'/>
  <rect x='35' y='32' width='16' height='5' rx='2' fill='#a8ddf0'/>

  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x='58' y='30' width='4' height='14' rx='2' fill='#889898'/>
  <rect x='56' y='28' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#aab8b8'/>

  <!-- smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='24' r='3' fill='#b0b8c0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='19' r='2.5' fill='#c0c8d0' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- smiling face on the hood -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#2a2050'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#2a2050'/>
  <circle cx='40.8' cy='57.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='48.8' cy='57.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 63 Q44 69 50 63' fill='none' stroke='#2a2050' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='63' r='2' fill='#f07050' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='63' r='2' fill='#f07050' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='58' r='4' fill='#f8f0a0'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#ffffe0'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
